1: // Minimal Cosmic Drift game implementation
2: // Assumes a <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800);
9:   const height = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
10: 
11:   // Game state
12:   let ship = { x: width / 2, y: height / 2, angle: 0, speed: 2, radius: 10 };
13:   const particles = [];
14:   const asteroids = [];
15:   let score = 0;
16:   let gameOver = false;
17: 
18:   // Input handling – mouse & touch set ship direction
19:   const setDirection = (clientX, clientY) => {
20:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
21:     const mx = clientX - rect.left;
22:     const my = clientY - rect.top;
23:     ship.angle = Math.atan2(my - ship.y, mx - ship.x);
24:   };
25:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => setDirection(e.clientX, e.clientY));
26:   canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
27:     e.preventDefault();
28:     const touch = e.touches[0];
29:     setDirection(touch.clientX, touch.clientY);
30:   }, { passive: false });
31: 
32:   // Helper functions
33:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
34:   const spawnParticle = () => {
35:     particles.push({
36:       x: Math.random() * width,
37:       y: Math.random() * height,
38:       radius: 3,
39:       vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
40:       vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
41:     });
42:   };
43:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
44:     const size = 15 + Math.random() * 25;
45:     asteroids.push({
46:       x: Math.random() * width,
47:       y: Math.random() * height,
48:       radius: size,
49:       vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
50:       vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
51:     });
52:   };
53: 
54:   // Initial spawns
55:   for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) spawnParticle();
56:   for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) spawnAsteroid();
57: 
58:   const update = () => {
59:     if (gameOver) return;
60:     // Move ship forward
61:     ship.x += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
62:     ship.y += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
63: 
64:     // Boundary lose condition
65:     if (ship.x < 0 || ship.x > width || ship.y < 0 || ship.y > height) {
66:       gameOver = true;
67:     }
68: 
69:     // Update particles (collect)
70:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
71:       const p = particles[i];
72:       p.x += p.vx;
73:       p.y += p.vy;
74:       // Wrap around edges for particles
75:       if (p.x < 0) p.x = width;
76:       if (p.x > width) p.x = 0;
77:       if (p.y < 0) p.y = height;
78:       if (p.y > height) p.y = 0;
79:       // Collection check
80:       if (dist(ship, p) < ship.radius + p.radius) {
81:         score++;
82:         particles.splice(i, 1);
83:         spawnParticle();
84:       }
85:     }
86: 
87:     // Update asteroids
88:     for (const a of asteroids) {
89:       a.x += a.vx;
90:       a.y += a.vy;
91:       // Bounce off walls
92:       if (a.x < a.radius || a.x > width - a.radius) a.vx *= -1;
93:       if (a.y < a.radius || a.y > height - a.radius) a.vy *= -1;
94:       // Collision with ship
95:       if (dist(ship, a) < ship.radius + a.radius) {
96:         gameOver = true;
97:       }
98:     }
99:   };
100: 
101:   const draw = () => {
102:     // Clear
103:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
104:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
105: 
106:     // Draw particles (glowing)
107:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
108:     for (const p of particles) {
109:       ctx.beginPath();
110:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
111:       ctx.fill();
112:     }
113: 
114:     // Draw asteroids
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
116:     for (const a of asteroids) {
117:       ctx.beginPath();
118:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
119:       ctx.fill();
120:     }
121: 
122:     // Draw ship (triangle)
123:     ctx.save();
124:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
125:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
126:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
127:     ctx.beginPath();
128:     ctx.moveTo( ship.radius, 0);
129:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, ship.radius / 2);
130:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, -ship.radius / 2);
131:     ctx.closePath();
132:     ctx.fill();
133:     ctx.restore();
134: 
135:     // UI
136:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
137:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
138:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
139:     if (gameOver) {
140:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
141:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
142:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 120, height / 2);
143:     }
144:   };
145: 
146:   const loop = () => {
147:     update();
148:     draw();
149:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
150:   };
151: 
152:   // Start loop
153:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
154: })();

(End of file - total 154 lines)
</content>
